title: Jack Rabbit Custard Doughnut E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: A rich, squishy and sweet custard doughnut is the sort of indulgent treat we wish we could eat all day. This irresistible e-liquid from Jack Rabbit, however, gives you all the creamy, pastry flavour of a real doughnut but with none of the calories – only super-satisfying all day vaping bliss. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
